description: Makes and unpacks Zen's folders for Tab Scout. Zen offers this only while its extensions.experiments.enabled setting is on.

functions.name: create
functions.description: Puts the loose tabs among tabIds into a new folder named title, in the space in front. Answers how many tabs went in.

functions.name: unpack
functions.description: Unpacks the folder with this tab group id, as Zen's Unpack Folder does. Answers {found, tabIds}: found is false when no such folder is left, and tabIds are the tabs that were in it, or null while the folder is in a space that is not in front and so stays as it is.
